headline: A Blue House. A Senate Cliffhanger.
dek: The 144,000-scenario Ervin Model centers on roughly 249 Democratic House seats, 50 Democratic-aligned Senate seats, and 27 Democratic governorships. Republicans have the narrower but meaningful Senate-control edge; simulations are sensitivity tests, not calibrated probabilities.
notes: 2026 forecast locked. Election-night homepage handoff at 17:55 Eastern; only verified unofficial returns may populate live mode. Forecast data is frozen.
